title: Medicines for PMOS
summary: NHS patient-facing summary of medicines commonly used to treat PMOS (formerly PCOS) symptoms: cycle regulation, fertility, hair growth, and acne.

chunks.text: NHS - source url: https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/polyendocrine-metabolic-ovarian-syndrome-pmos/ Medicines for PMOS PMOS symptoms are sometimes treated with: ● the combined pill, progestogen-only pill or an intrauterine system (IUS), to help with irregular periods ● clomifene, a medicine used to improve fertility ● spironolactone or eflornithine to help reduce hair growth on the face and body ● metformin, a type 2 diabetes medicine to help tiredness and weight problems ● skins creams or tablets that can help acne
